about: Follow-up destinations the picker can put on a QR (fu=id[.YYYYMMDD[.HHMM]]). Optional per-trust layer: no file = no follow-up row in the picker. 'where', 'phone' and 'note' render on the patient page only when present; 'find_url' renders a 'How to find it' button linking the trust's OWN published directions page (open and check the page before adding — never model memory); 'checked' is when the where/find facts were last read on that page. 'info_slug' offers the matching trust leaflet as a one-tap add. Added Oscar 2026-09-03; wayfinding links same day.

destinations.label: SDEC — Gloucestershire Royal
destinations.name: Same Day Emergency Care (SDEC), Gloucestershire Royal Hospital
destinations.where: First floor of the main outpatient department — use the Atrium entrance.
destinations.note: Bring your medicines and any letters you were given.
